# awbonsai

> Run a real model in the visitor's own browser — no server round trip, no upload.

Every in-browser LLM demo either phones home for the real answer or downloads a few hundred MB unasked. Getting BOTH right -- genuinely local inference, and a consent gate that runs BEFORE the fetch instead of after -- is the part nobody ships, so most "runs in your browser" claims are marketing for a server call.

## Install

```
git clone https://github.com/Aitherium/awbonsai
```

## Use it in 30 seconds

Load one page and get an answer from a model that never left the tab.

## Composes with

- [awkit](https://aitherium.github.io/awkit/) — Render an agent panel from a tool result — one component, any React app.
- [awsprite](https://aitherium.github.io/awsprite/) — Hatch a companion that grows only from what you teach it, then take it home.
- [AitherConnect](https://aitherium.github.io/AitherConnect/) — Browser extension — federated AI search, page context, and the Living OS overlay.
- [awasp](https://aitherium.github.io/awasp/) — Stream a multi-gigabyte model onto a device that cannot hold it all at once.

## Where it lives

- Repo: https://github.com/Aitherium/awbonsai

This repository is mirrored from the AitherOS monorepo by `.github/workflows/sync-awbonsai.yml`; hand edits made here are overwritten on the next sync — change the source instead.

Everything Aitherium, in one file for agents: https://aitherium.com/llms.txt
